newsitem.title: UK: ASDA wins Puffin Biscuits case.
newsitem.headline: ASDA wins Puffin Biscuits case.

text.p: UK supermarket group ASDA Group Plc said on Tuesday that London's High Court had ruled that ASDA could continue to call its biscuits Puffins, although with minor changes to their packaging.
ASDA said in a statement the ruling was a victory over the Penguin brand of chocolate biscuits made by United Biscuits (Holdings) Plc.
Britain's supermarkets have increasingly promoted their own brand items, many of which resemble established brand-name products but are generally cheaper.

"Since we launched ASDA Puffins over 40 million have been sold without a single customer complaint about confusion between the two. Since the launch, Penguin sales have hardly altered yet sales of Puffin have been four times higher," Ian McLeod, ASDA grocery director said in a statement.
A spokeswoman for United Biscuits said a statement would be released later in the day.
